svg.title: Commit Cosmos — Srivaths' contribution flight
svg.desc: An autoplay space-shooter scene. Each star tile is a real public contribution-calendar day; its brightness shows contribution intensity, not a game score. The ship targets ten tiles from below. A tile flashes orange when struck, then stays burned until the 26-second scene resets.
svg.text: I can do this all day. One commit at a time.
REAL PUBLIC CONTRIBUTION DATA / AUTOPLAY SCENE
